questions.question: AWS core services — EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC là gì?

options.A: Tất cả chỉ là server ảo
options.B: EC2: virtual machines. S3: object storage. RDS: managed relational DB. Lambda: serverless functions. VPC: isolated network. IAM: identity management
options.D: Lambda là như EC2 nhưng nhanh hơn

questions.explanation: EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud): VMs, choose instance type (t3.micro, c6g.xlarge). S3 (Simple Storage Service): object store, 99.999999999% durability, static website hosting, infinite scale. RDS: managed MySQL/PostgreSQL/Aurora — auto backup, patching, Multi-AZ. Lambda: serverless, auto-scale, pay per invocation, max 15 min timeout. VPC (Virtual Private Cloud): isolated network, subnets (public/private), security groups, NACLs. IAM: users, roles, policies. ECS/EKS: container orchestration. CloudFront: CDN.

questions.question: IAM roles, policies, và least privilege principle?

options.A: Dùng root account cho tất cả
options.B: IAM: users, groups, roles, policies. Least privilege: chỉ cấp permissions cần thiết. Roles: tạm thời, cho EC2/Lambda/external. Policy: JSON định nghĩa Allow/Deny actions
options.C: 1 IAM user cho cả team là đủ

questions.explanation: Policy JSON: {Version, Statement: [{Effect:Allow, Action:[s3:GetObject], Resource:arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*}]}. Identity-based vs resource-based policies. Managed policies (AWS managed, Customer managed) vs inline policies. Roles: không permanent credentials, assume role (STS). EC2 instance profile: role attached to EC2, no need to hardcode credentials. Least privilege: start with deny all, add only needed. MFA: multi-factor authentication cho sensitive operations. AWS Organizations: multiple accounts, Service Control Policies.

questions.question: S3 storage classes và lifecycle policies?

options.B: Standard (frequent access), Intelligent-Tiering (auto), Standard-IA (infrequent), Glacier (archive). Lifecycle rules: auto transition between classes, auto delete

questions.explanation: Storage classes: S3 Standard (99.99% availability, frequent access). S3 Standard-IA (Infrequent Access): cheaper storage, per-retrieval fee. S3 Glacier: archival, retrieval 1-12h. Glacier Instant Retrieval: ms retrieval. Glacier Deep Archive: cheapest, 12h retrieval. Intelligent-Tiering: auto move between tiers based on access patterns. Lifecycle: transition to IA after 30 days, Glacier after 90 days, delete after 365 days. Versioning: keep all versions, undelete. Cross-region replication. S3 Object Lock: WORM compliance.

questions.question: AWS VPC — subnets, security groups, NACLs?

options.B: Public subnet: internet gateway. Private subnet: NAT gateway. Security groups: stateful, instance level. NACLs: stateless, subnet level. Bastion host cho SSH
options.C: Security groups và NACLs giống nhau

questions.explanation: VPC: CIDR block (10.0.0.0/16). Public subnet: route table → Internet Gateway → internet access. Private subnet: route table → NAT Gateway → outbound internet, no inbound. Security Group: stateful (return traffic auto allowed), instance/ENI level. Allow rules only. NACL: stateless (must allow both inbound AND outbound), subnet level. Allow and deny rules. VPC Peering: connect VPCs. VPN: site-to-site VPN, client VPN. Direct Connect: dedicated network. PrivateLink: private endpoint cho AWS services.

questions.question: Deploy containerized app lên AWS ECS Fargate?

options.B: ECR: store Docker images. ECS Fargate: serverless containers. Task Definition: container spec. Service: desired count, load balancer. ALB: HTTP routing

questions.explanation: Workflow: (1) Build và push image lên ECR. (2) Task Definition: container image, CPU/memory, env vars, port mappings, log config (CloudWatch). (3) ECS Cluster + Fargate launch type (no EC2 management). (4) ECS Service: desired tasks, ALB integration, auto-scaling. (5) ALB: Target Group → ECS Service. Fargate: serverless, pay per vCPU/memory per second. vs EC2 launch type: manage your own EC2 instances. Service auto-scaling: target tracking (CPU%). Blue/green deployment với CodeDeploy.

questions.question: AWS Lambda cold start — nguyên nhân và cách giảm?

options.B: Cold start: khởi tạo execution environment. Reduce bằng: Provisioned Concurrency, smaller package, keep-warm, runtime selection (Go/Rust nhanh hơn Java)
options.C: Tăng memory giải quyết cold start
options.D: Cold start chỉ xảy ra với Python

questions.explanation: Cold start: Lambda cần create execution environment (download code, start runtime, run init code). Thường 1-5s. Warm start: reuse existing environment (<10ms). Factors: runtime (Java/C# chậm, Python/Node/Go nhanh), package size (smaller = faster), init code amount. Reduce: (1) Provisioned Concurrency: pre-warm instances ($$$). (2) Keep-warm: EventBridge rule ping Lambda mỗi 5 phút (cho free tier). (3) Reduce package size: tree shaking, exclude test files. (4) Move heavy init ngoài handler. (5) SnapStart (Java): snapshot execution environment. (6) Container images: cold start tương tự zip.

questions.question: Design highly available 3-tier web app trên AWS?

options.B: Multi-AZ: ALB → EC2 Auto Scaling Group (multiple AZs) → RDS Multi-AZ + Read Replicas. CloudFront CDN. Route 53 health checks. ElastiCache Redis

questions.explanation: HA architecture: (1) CloudFront CDN → static assets S3, dynamic → ALB. (2) Route 53: DNS failover. (3) ALB: cross-zone load balancing, health checks. (4) Auto Scaling Group: min/max/desired, scale on CPU/request count, multi-AZ. (5) RDS Multi-AZ: synchronous replication, auto failover (< 2min). Read Replicas: offload reads. (6) ElastiCache Redis: session store, caching. (7) All in private subnets, NAT Gateway cho outbound. (8) AWS Secrets Manager: DB credentials. (9) CloudWatch: monitoring, alarms, auto-scaling triggers. (10) S3 + CloudFront: static assets với global CDN.
